Quest Compute Cluster Maintenance and Update Notes

Quest Compute Cluster Maintenance and Update Notes#

Major updates to Northwestern’s HPC system Quest are documented here.

ColdFront Platform Launch - June 2026

  • The ColdFront platform is live and available for researchers.

  • ColdFront documentation is available to help researchers with the new platform’s functionality.

Slurm and GPU performance updates - June 2026

  • Upgraded Quest’s job scheduler, Slurm, to version 25.11.5 that provides options for faster job recovery and improved job monitoring. Reference the full Slurm changelog for details.

  • Updated the GPU driver to CUDA 13.3 for improved GPU performance, enhanced libraries, updated tooling, and support for emerging AI models.

  • Upgraded GPU-to-GPU communications: Multi-GPU jobs can now utilize direct GPU-to-GPU communication with the new CUDA-aware UCX upgrade.

  • Updated FastX to version 4 to provide a more reliable and secure remote desktop experience.

  • Upgraded the storage system firmware and InfiniBand interconnect drivers and applied security patches to system software to enhance cluster stability.

  • Performed power and cooling equipment maintenance to ensure the healthy operation of the computing infrastructure.

Slurm and license server updates - September 2025

  • Upgraded Quest’s job scheduler, Slurm, to version 24.11.6. Reference the full Slurm changelog for details.

  • Upgraded the license server for licensed software on Quest and applied patches to all nodes to improve the security of the cluster.

  • Upgraded the storage system firmware and InfiniBand interconnect drivers to enhance cluster stability.

  • Performed power and cooling equipment maintenance to ensure the healthy operation of the computing infrastructure.

OS and Storage Update - 31 March 2025

  • Updated operating system on all nodes from RHEL7 to RHEL8.

  • Storage migration

  • Flash storage addition

  • Firewall changes

  • Replaced many system libraries with modules
